# Expose host call implementations

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

This PR moves the host calls around a bit and exposes all of them in `jam-host-calls` package.
There is no particular reason imho why these would not be exposed and I also intend to use them in `pvm-debugger`.

## Walkthrough

This PR reorganizes the `jam-host-calls` module structure by introducing namespace-based organization through three new barrel index files (accumulate, general, refine) and updating import paths throughout the codebase. The refactoring consolidates ~50 files, moving imports to reflect the new directory structure where modules are grouped under centralized namespaces. Additionally, a try/finally cleanup pattern is added to LMDB resource tests, and the main index exports are restructured to expose public APIs through three namespaced groups instead of flat exports. No runtime logic changes are introduced beyond reorganization and import resolution adjustments.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes

**Areas requiring extra attention:**
- **Barrel files verification**: Confirm that all three new index files (accumulate, general, refine) correctly re-export their respective modules and there are no omissions or circular dependencies
- **Import path consistency**: Spot-check a representative sample of the repetitive import path changes across accumulate and refine subdirectories to ensure the pattern was applied uniformly (e.g., `../results.js` → `../general/results.js`)
- **PVM executor rewiring**: Verify that the PvmExecutor changes correctly map all explicit class imports to their namespaced equivalents (e.g., `Bless` → `accumulate.Bless`, `LogHostCall` → `general.LogHostCall`) and that all 13 accumulate call handlers are properly wired
- **Public API surface changes**: Ensure the restructured main index exports in `packages/jam/jam-host-calls/index.ts` maintain backward compatibility or document breaking changes for consumers relying on flat export paths
- **LMDB resource cleanup**: Verify that the try/finally pattern in tests consistently closes both `states` and `root` resources

## Possibly related PRs

- **#562**: Modifies fetch-externalities typing and PVM executor usage, switching to `IFetchExternalities` and generalized fetch externalities—directly overlaps with this PR's IFetchExternalities integration in PvmExecutor
- **#487**: Reorganizes host-call imports/types under jam-host-calls general/accumulate namespaces and updates PvmExecutor/PartialStateDb usages—core restructuring that this PR implements
- **#575**: Modifies jam-host-calls export/import surface by adding centralized barrels and namespaces (general/accumulate)—parallel reorganization effort with shared goals
